question: Who sees gem reality quickly?
premises: so hungry selves quickly very certain indeed
inference: The verse says hungry selves quickly see gem reality with certainty despite inner obstacles.
uncertainties: whether vighnāntaratirodhitaḥ modifies paśyanti or bubhukṣitātmānaḥ
plain_english: Gem etc. reality they see, obstructed by inner obstacle; so hungry selves quickly, very certain indeed.
